meta.hardware: Apple Silicon CPU, torch 2.10.0, transformers 5.18.0, eager math SDPA
meta.units: nats of native Yes-minus-No logit gap; sufficiency = absent run patched with present-condition value; necessity = present run patched with absent value
meta.precision_note: Primary numbers BF16 on CPU (same op sequence as training; bitwise equal to HF Qwen3DecoderLayer on CPU). FP32 replicate given separately. CPU BF16 differs from archived CUDA BF16 scores by <=0.25 nats.
meta.head: block 35, query head 6 (zero-indexed); its GQA key/value head is kv head 1
meta.mechanism: Block 34 rotates the probe's tiny constant footprint on the `user` role token into the one residual direction that trained kv-head-1 W_K reads at a nearly cancelled key; Qwen3's k_norm rescales that small key, so L35H6's answer query switches its attention from </think> (value writes No) to `user` (value writes Yes): a key-driven attention switch, not a value/OV difference.

dose_response_bf16.site: block-34 input, user row: x_absent + alpha * delta34

key_dims_bf16.note: post-rope head-6 key at `user`; contribution_i = q_i * dk_i / sqrt(128); band j = dims j, j+64 (j=0 highest rotary frequency, j=63 lowest)

dose_response_fine_bf16.site: block-34 input `user` row of the absent run: x + alpha * delta34

random_direction_control_bf16.note: isotropic random vectors added to the absent `user` row; norm = scale * |delta| at that site (|delta34| = 5.487, |delta35| ~ 17.8); key_rowspace = random within head 6's 128-d W_K row space
